articles.summary: Prior authorization is one of the biggest sources of administrative burden in healthcare, and it is now the subject of a regulatory deadline. CMS-0057-F and HTI-4 require payers and providers to support electronic prior authorization workflows built on FHIR, with enforcement beginning January 2027.
articles.title: Preparing for 2027 Prior Auth Regulatory Requirements

articles.summary: Everself is building the second line of defense for obesity care. Every month, more than a million patients drop off GLP-1 medications, and most regain the weight within three to six months. Until now, the only durable alternative has been invasive bariatric surgery, which can require weeks away from work. Everself fills the gap with an outpatient endoscopic weight loss procedure that delivers bariatric-level results without surgery, wrapped in a longitudinal care program delivered by a full care team.
articles.title: Everself: Enhanced Obesity Care
